topic: How to help your teen price their first paid gig
caption:
Most teens underprice themselves and quit before they start.

Help your teen research what one service costs in your neighborhood, then set a rate they can defend with confidence.

A simple script helps: 'I charge $20/hr and I'll send you a text when I'm done.' That's it.

copy.headline: Help Your Teen Price Their First Gig Right
copy.body: Start with what neighbors pay locally, then add 10-20% for reliability. A teen who shows up on time and communicates well can charge $15-$25/hr for lawn care, pet sitting, or tech help.
